COMMAND='
  printf '%q ' "$@"
  echo

  set +e
  "$@" >"$log" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  set -e

  cat "$log"

  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\tPASS\t0\n' "$id" >> "$E/results.tsv"
    echo "STEP_RESULT=PASS step=$id"
    return 0
  fi

  printf '%s\tFAIL\t%s\n' "$id" "$rc" >> "$E/results.tsv"

  # Reconfirm source checkout untouched before terminating.
  git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse HEAD > "$E/source-head.after"
  git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" status --porcelain=v1 -uall > "$E/source-status.after"

  diff -u "$E/source-head.before" "$E/source-head.after" \
    >"$E/source-head.diff" || true
  diff -u "$E/source-status.before" "$E/source-status.after" \
    >"$E/source-status.diff" || true

  if ! cmp -s "$E/source-head.before" "$E/source-head.after" ||
     ! cmp -s "$E/source-status.before" "$E/source-status.after"; then
    echo "SOURCE_REPOSITORY_INVARIANT=FAIL"
    echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
    exit 98
  fi

  echo "SOURCE_REPOSITORY_INVARIANT=PASS"
  echo "LOCAL_REPRO=FAIL"
  echo "FIRST_FAILED_STEP=$id"
  echo "FIRST_FAILED_EXIT_CODE=$rc"
  echo "FAILED_LOG=$log"
  echo "SEMAPHORE_QUERY=NO"
  echo "SEMAPHORE_RERUN=NO"
  echo "VPS_ACCESS=NO"
  echo "PRODUCTION_ACCESS=NO"
  echo "REPOSITORY_PUSH=NO"
  echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
  exit "$rc"
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact Semaphore production-fallback Core CI contract preconditions.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_step 00_preflight bash -c '
  set -euo pipefail
  test "${SEMAPHORE_WORKFLOW_TRIGGERED_BY_API:-false}" = "true"
  test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "feature/GRU"
  [[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
  test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "'"$SHA"'"
'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact unit-test sequence from .semaphore/semaphore-production.yml
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_step 01_test_ci_breaker \

run_step 02_test_orphan_recovery_wait \

run_step 03_test_plan01_data_foundation \
  python3 -m unittest -v apy.tests.test_gru_plan01_data_foundation.DataLoaderPlan01Tests

run_step 04_test_p2_memory_bound \
  python3 -m unittest -v ops.ci.tests.test_p2_memory_bound_contract

run_step 05_test_raw_payload_persistence \

run_step 06_test_full_corpus_durability \

run_step 07_test_p1_dependency_validator \

run_step 08_test_p2_handoff_state_machine \
  python3 -m unittest -v ops.ci.tests.test_p2_handoff_state_machine

run_step 09_test_p2_external_evidence \

run_step 10_test_post_p2_live_acceptance \

run_step 11_test_post_p2_live_durability \
  python3 -m unittest -v ops.ci.tests.test_post_p2_live_durability

run_step 12_test_single_commit_semaphore \
  python3 -m unittest -v ops.ci.tests.test_single_commit_semaphore_contract

run_step 13_test_minimum_history_boundary \
  python3 -m unittest -v apy.tests.test_gru_minimum_history_boundary

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact Python syntax checks from production YAML.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_step 14_python_syntax \
  python3 -m py_compile \
    ops/ci/breaker/ci_breaker.py \
    ops/gru/remediate_orphan_recovery_wait.py \
    apy/backfill/finalize_history_memory_bounded.py \
    apy/backfill/finalize_history_memory_bounded_entry.py \
    apy/model_process/gru/train_predict_gru.py \
    apy/raw_payload_persistence.py \
    apy/tests/test_raw_payload_persistence.py \
    ops/ci/tests/test_full_corpus_durability_contract.py

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact shell syntax checks. bash -n parses only; it does not execute.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_step 15_shell_syntax \
  bash -n \
    apy/model_train_guard.sh \
    ops/ci/circleci_dispatch_feature_gru.sh \
    ops/ci/deploy_feature_gru_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/prepare_deploy_contract.sh \
    ops/ci/circleci_dispatch_gru_p2.sh \
    ops/ci/circleci_observe_gru_p2.sh \
    ops/ci/launch_gru_p2_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/observe_gru_p2_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/run_gru_p2_worker_wrapper.sh \
    ops/ci/run_gru_p2_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/launch_gru_full_corpus_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/supervise_gru_full_corpus.sh \
    ops/ci/observe_gru_full_corpus_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/run_gru_full_corpus_worker_wrapper.sh \
    ops/ci/status_gru_full_corpus.sh \
    ops/ci/verify_gru_full_corpus_evidence.sh \
    ops/ci/gru_p2_state.sh \
    ops/ci/launch_post_p2_live_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/supervise_post_p2_live.sh \
    ops/ci/observe_post_p2_live_remote.sh \
    ops/ci/run_post_p2_live_acceptance_remote.sh

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact static contracts from production YAML.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
run_step 16_owner_contract \
  grep -Fq 'owner=user-cron sudo_required=false' \
    ops/ci/launch_gru_full_corpus_remote.sh

run_step 17_flock_contract \
  grep -Fq 'flock --nonblock 9' \
    ops/ci/supervise_gru_full_corpus.sh

run_step 18_lock_wait_contract \
  grep -Fq 'BOT_TRAD_GLOBAL_TRAIN_LOCK_WAIT_SECS=unlimited' \
    ops/ci/run_gru_full_corpus_worker_wrapper.sh

run_step 19_worker_log_contract \
  grep -Fq 'exec >> "$result_dir/worker.log" 2>&1' \
    ops/ci/run_gru_full_corpus_worker_wrapper.sh

run_step 20_sudo_free_contract bash -c '
  set -euo pipefail
  if grep -nE "^[[:space:]]*sudo([[:space:]]|$)" \
       ops/ci/launch_gru_full_corpus_remote.sh \
       ops/ci/supervise_gru_full_corpus.sh \
       ops/ci/run_gru_full_corpus_worker_wrapper.sh \
       ops/ci/observe_gru_full_corpus_remote.sh; then
    echo "ERROR: full-corpus live runtime must be sudo-free" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
'

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prove source checkout remained byte/state-equivalent from Git's view.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse HEAD > "$E/source-head.after"
git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" status --porcelain=v1 -uall > "$E/source-status.after"

cmp -s "$E/source-head.before" "$E/source-head.after" \
  || fail "SOURCE_HEAD_CHANGED" 120

cmp -s "$E/source-status.before" "$E/source-status.after" \
  || fail "SOURCE_WORKTREE_CHANGED" 121

echo "================================================================"
cat "$E/results.tsv"
echo "SOURCE_REPOSITORY_INVARIANT=PASS"
echo "LOCAL_EXACT_SHA_VALIDATION=PASS"
echo "VALIDATED_SHA=$SHA"
echo "SEMAPHORE_QUERY=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_RERUN=NO"
echo "VPS_ACCESS=NO"
echo "PRODUCTION_ACCESS=NO"
echo "REPOSITORY_PUSH=NO"
echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
